result:
Done. The change is merged to main and all 25 tests pass.

What changed:
- `src/format.js`: formatPrice now takes a required currency. It maps USD to `$` and EUR to `€`, and throws on a missing or unknown currency so a wrong symbol can never print silently.
- `src/report.js`: invoiceLine gained a currency parameter and passes it through. It was the only caller in src.
- `test/basic.test.js`: formatPrice is tested for USD, EUR, and the missing-currency throw. The invoiceLine test passes USD.

During shipping, main moved four times under other sessions. The conflict agent that ship.sh calls merged each time. One of those merges added orderTotal on main, a new formatPrice caller. It now passes USD with a shortcut comment, since orders had no currency to pass.

SHIPPED

Skipped: src2 has its own copy of formatPrice without a currency argument. The task named src/format.js, so I left src2 alone. Risk: orderTotal is hard-wired to USD until it gets a currency parameter.
